blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Second Congressional Commission on Education (Edcom 2) has called on youth-serving organizations to participate in a consultation that seeks to bring young Filipinos’ experiences and insights directly into the country’s education reform process. The initiative seeks to gather youth perspectives through an arts-based module that participating organizations can conduct with the young people they serve. The module, developed through a partnership with the AHA Learning Center, the Philippine Educational Theater Association, Save the Children Philippines, and the University of the Philippines Ugnayan ng Pahinungod, covers key concerns such as literacy, school safety and bullying, socio-emotional and life […]...
